direction_summaries.explanation: This neuron is a “discourse‐marker” detector: it lights up on the little tokens that signal informal or conversational phrasing—contractions and ’s (don’t, that’s, it’s), trailing ellipses (…), and short action or stance words (tap, burn, decrypt/crypt, am, great) that typically occur in quoted speech, imperatives or procedural/instructional passages. It thus flags the bits of text that carry the speaker’s or writer’s conversational tone and structural cues.
